title: Full function over supply voltage range
procedure: Set ambient 23 °C, window normalized. Set supply to 9.0 V, then 12 V, then 16.0 V; also 8.9 V and 16.1 V for reference only. At each voltage perform manual open/close, express open/close, anti-pinch trigger and read WLC_Status. Record any function not available.
pass_criteria: Function availability (manual, express, anti-pinch, CAN status) at 9.0 V, 12 V and 16.0 V: full function from 9.0 V to 16.0 V

title: Reduced voltage range: manual only, express disabled
procedure: Window normalized, 23 °C. Set supply to 8.9 V, 7.5 V and 6.1 V. At each voltage, make a short press (<300 ms) in open and close directions. Hold the switch to move the window manually in both directions. Set supply to 9.1 V and repeat the short press as a reference.
pass_criteria: Express mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V: disabled; Manual mode between 6.0 V and 9.0 V: operates in manual mode only

title: Motor stop on undervoltage
procedure: Run the motor in manual mode at 12 V. Step supply from 12 V to 5.9 V and capture supply and motor current with a scope; trigger on the voltage crossing 6.0 V. Repeat with the step to 5.0 V. Measure time from crossing 6.0 V to motor current zero.
pass_criteria: Time from supply below 6.0 V to motor stopped: within 50 ms

title: Sleep current
procedure: Supply 12 V (13.5 V optional second point), 23 °C. Put the controller in sleep mode (ignition off, no CAN activity, wait for sleep timeout). Measure supply current with a calibrated microammeter after settling. Repeat at -40 °C and 85 °C.
pass_criteria: Sleep mode supply current: < 100 µA

title: Reverse battery withstand
procedure: Connect supply with reversed polarity at -14 V for 60 s, 23 °C. Restore the correct polarity at 13.5 V. Run the functional check: movement, CAN, diagnostics, sleep current.
pass_criteria: Controller condition after -14 V for 60 s: without damage

title: Manual mode movement and stop on release
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window mid-travel. Hold the switch in close and in open direction for 1 s; observe window movement. Release the switch; capture the switch signal and motor drive. Measure time from release to motor stopped; repeat 10 times in each direction.
pass_criteria: Window movement while switch held: moves while the switch is held; Time from switch release to window stopped: within 100 ms

title: Window movement after ignition off
procedure: Case A: switch ignition off, keep doors closed, press switch at 55 s and at 61 s after ignition off. Case B: ignition off, open a front door at 20 s, then press the switch just before (19 s) and just after the opening event. Case C: open a rear door only at 20 s and press the switch. Record whether the window moves.
pass_criteria: Window movement after ignition off: allowed for 60 s or until a front door is opened, whichever comes first

title: Express mode start by short press
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window mid-travel. Apply switch presses of 100 ms, 290 ms and 299 ms in close direction, then in open direction. Apply presses of 301 ms and 350 ms as outside-limit points. Observe whether the window continues after release.
pass_criteria: Express mode start for press shorter than 300 ms: starts express mode in the pressed direction

title: Stop express movement with second press
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Start express close; during travel press the switch in close direction again. Repeat with a press in open direction. Repeat for express open with both press directions. Measure time from second press to motor stopped.
pass_criteria: Time from second press to window stopped: within 100 ms

title: Full travel time
procedure: Set supply 13.5 V and chamber/ambient 23 °C, normalized. Start express close from fully open (480 mm). Measure time to fully closed (0 mm) from CAN position/motor signals. Repeat 5 times.
pass_criteria: Fully open to fully closed travel time at 13.5 V and 23 °C: 3.0 s to 4.5 s

title: Motor stop at end positions
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Express close to 0 mm and express open to 480 mm. Observe the motor current and drive at each end position.
pass_criteria: Motor state at end position: motor stopped when the window reaches the end position

title: CAN WLC_CloseAll
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window open. Send CAN WLC_CloseAll from the restbus simulation. Observe the window closing without the switch. During closing, place a pinch obstacle in the pinch zone and verify reaction. Repeat from mid-travel.
pass_criteria: Window response to WLC_CloseAll: closes the window in express mode; Anti-pinch during CloseAll closing: anti-pinch protection active

title: Express close only when normalized
procedure: Make the controller not normalized (supply interruption of 600 ms). Short press in close direction at mid-travel; observe. Normalize per TC-022 procedure. Repeat short press close.
pass_criteria: Express close when not normalized: not available; Express close when normalized: available

title: Pinch detection threshold
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Use force-measuring pinch fixture with calibrated spring rate. Close in the pinch zone with obstacle at 100 mm; ramp force to 78 N, 80 N and 82 N. Repeat at 5 mm and 199 mm positions. Repeat above 200 mm and below 4 mm as outside-zone reference.
pass_criteria: Pinch detection in pinch zone: detects a pinch when the pinch force exceeds 80 N

title: Pinch reaction: stop time and reversal distance
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Trigger a pinch at 100 mm; capture motor drive and position. Measure time from detection to motor stop. Measure reversal distance. Trigger a pinch at 4 mm and at 200 mm. Trigger where less than 150 mm of travel remains to fully open (reduced stroke setup).
pass_criteria: Time from pinch detection to motor stop: within 10 ms; Reversal distance after pinch: at least 150 mm or to fully open, whichever is less

title: Anti-pinch active in manual and express modes
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Close in manual mode and apply pinch obstacle exceeding 80 N in the pinch zone. Close in express mode and apply the same obstacle. Observe reaction.
pass_criteria: Anti-pinch in manual mode: active; Anti-pinch in express mode: active

title: Anti-pinch disabled when not normalized
procedure: Interrupt supply for 600 ms to make the controller not normalized. Close in manual mode and apply an obstacle exceeding 80 N in the pinch zone. Observe the reaction and WLC_Status normalization state.
pass_criteria: Anti-pinch when not normalized: disabled

title: Express close inhibit after pinch reversal
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Trigger a pinch reversal; mark time t0 when reversal ends. Attempt express close (short press) at t0+1.9 s and at t0+2.1 s. Record response each time.
pass_criteria: Express close after pinch reversal: inhibited for 2 s

title: Repeated pinch lockout to manual close
procedure: 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Trigger three pinches within 30 s (e.g. 10 s apart). Attempt express close, then manual close, immediately and at 59 s and 61 s after the third pinch. Control case: three pinches spread over more than 30 s, then attempt express close (after 2 s inhibit).
pass_criteria: Closing after three pinch detections within 30 s: allowed only in manual mode for the next 60 s

title: Position resolution from Hall pulses
procedure: Inject Hall pulse sequences simulating motor travel. Step the simulated position by single pulses and compare WLC_Status position with a reference. Check position values across 0 mm to 480 mm.
pass_criteria: Position resolution: 0.5 mm or better

title: Loss of normalization after supply interruption
procedure: Controller normalized at 13.5 V. Interrupt supply for 400 ms, 500 ms and 600 ms (and 2 s) in separate runs. After each, read normalization state in WLC_Status. Re-normalize between runs.
pass_criteria: Normalization state after supply interruption longer than 500 ms: not normalized

title: Normalization at closed seal
procedure: Start from not normalized state. In manual mode hold close with window fully closed against seal for 0.9 s, then release; read state. Repeat holding for 1.0 s and 1.1 s. Repeat in express mode attempt (not applicable) and with window not at seal as reference.
pass_criteria: Normalization after window held fully closed against seal in manual mode: normalizes after 1 s

title: Thermal model existence
procedure: Review the software design and thermal model documentation. Verify that motor temperature is estimated with a thermal model and what inputs it uses. Record the model accuracy requirement, if any.
pass_criteria: Motor temperature estimation by thermal model: [TBD: limit needed]

title: Thermal current limit and blocking
procedure: Drive the thermal model state via test interface/simulated duty to set the estimated motor temperature. Set 129 °C, then 131 °C; measure motor current while driving. Raise to 139 °C, then 141 °C; attempt opening and closing. Lower the estimate to 121 °C, then 119 °C; attempt opening.
pass_criteria: Motor current above 130 °C estimated: limited to 15 A; Operation above 140 °C estimated: opening blocked, closing only allowed; Thermal blocking end: ends when estimated temperature falls below 120 °C

title: WLC_Status cycle time and content
procedure: Log WLC_Status on CAN for 60 s while idle and while moving. Compute the period between consecutive messages. Decode position, movement state, normalization state and fault state; compare to the simulated conditions.
pass_criteria: WLC_Status period: 50 ms ± 5 ms; Message content: contains window position, movement state, normalization state and fault state

title: Hall sensor loss DTC B1A01
procedure: Drive the motor and remove the Hall signal for 150 ms, then restore; check DTCs. Remove Hall signal for 250 ms while driving; check DTC and motor. Remove Hall signal with motor not driven as a reference.
pass_criteria: DTC B1A01 when Hall signal missing while motor driven: stored when missing for more than 200 ms; Motor on Hall loss: stopped

title: Overcurrent DTC B1A02 reactions
procedure: Using the electronic load/blocked motor, apply 24 A for 100 ms, then 26 A for 40 ms, then 26 A for 60 ms. Read DTCs, motor drive state and WLC_Status fault state after each run.
pass_criteria: DTC B1A02 storage: stored when motor current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms; Motor when B1A02 stored: stopped; WLC_Status fault state when B1A02 stored: set

title: Diagnostic response time
procedure: Send 100 diagnostic requests (e.g. read DTC) via the tester. Measure request-to-response time on the CAN log, also while the window is moving.
pass_criteria: Diagnostic response time: within 50 ms

title: Operating temperature range
procedure: Place controller with motor load in the chamber; soak at -40 °C, then 85 °C (also 23 °C reference), at least 2 h each. At each temperature at 13.5 V run manual and express movement, anti-pinch trigger and CAN status check.
pass_criteria: Controller operation at -40 °C and 85 °C: operates from -40 °C to 85 °C

title: Wake-up time from sleep
procedure: Put controller in sleep mode at 13.5 V, 23 °C. Press the switch; capture the switch signal and first motor drive/CAN activity. Measure time from press to wake; repeat 10 times, also at -40 °C and 85 °C.
pass_criteria: Wake time from sleep after switch press: within 100 ms
